scope: Corrected baked body+shadow atlases: straight-right connected shadow, no square matte, larger 82px placement proof scale.

source_generation.method: built_in_imagegen body sources plus built_in_imagegen straight-right white-background shadow source
source_generation.body_sources: Accepted TargetMatchV5 static facings and soldier_animation_v5 frames.
source_generation.postprocess: luminance-to-alpha extraction from white-background imagegen shadow source, split/normalize to 256 cells, deterministic compositing under imagegen body frames, atlas packing, contact sheet, placement proof, metadata and validation

correction_from_v8.v8_problem: shadow was too faint after removing border artifact; user requested straight-right not right-bottom; soldiers in proof were too small
correction_from_v8.v9_fix: straight-right/east cast from foot contact, white-source alpha avoids square matte, proof scale increased from 64px to 82px height

assessment.player_shadow: V9 is straight-right, connected to the boot contact, and avoids the square matte artifact seen in v8. Placement proof uses larger 82px soldiers to better match the mockup scale.
assessment.enemy_shadow: V9 enemy frames use the same straight-right baked cast and no separate runtime shadow layer is needed.
assessment.remaining: Needs PM/user visual approval and Gameplay runtime proof using v9 baked atlases.
